label: basic range 90-110 of applicable FMR
notes: PHA may set any amount in the range without HUD approval or prior notice. Must revise within 3 months of a new FMR if needed to stay in range.

label: ZIP exception up to 110 of SAFMR
notes: PHA not in a designated/opt-in SAFMR area may set a ZIP exception up to 110% of that ZIP's SAFMR without HUD approval. Whole ZIP only.

label: exception 110-120 with HUD notice
notes: Allowed for a HUD-specified duration if success rate <75%, or >40% of families pay >30% of adjusted income, or other Secretary criteria.

label: exception above 110 needs HUD approval
notes: Unless (d)(2)/(3)/(5) apply. Must submit rental-market data for the exception area vs the FMR area.

label: reasonable accommodation up to 120
notes: Individual family, 24 CFR part 8, no HUD approval up to 120% of applicable FMR. Above 120% needs HUD approval.

label: below 90 of FMR
notes: HUD sole discretion. Will not approve if it would put >40% of TBRA families over 30% rent burden unless needed to prevent terminations.
